description: A React component for rendering and managing an application form within Mattermost, including validation, lookup, and modal rendering.

classes.name: AppsForm
classes.description: React component class for rendering and handling an app form with validation, submission, and modal display.

methods.name: validateDateFieldValue
methods.description: Validates date or datetime field values, warns if datetime format is used for date fields.

methods.name: validateAppField
methods.description: Validates individual app form fields for correct formats and constraints.

methods.name: getSafeDateValue
methods.description: Returns a sanitized date string without mutation, handling relative dates.

methods.name: createSanitizedField
methods.description: Creates a sanitized copy of an AppField with valid time intervals and date values.

methods.name: initFormValues
methods.description: Initializes form values with default or current time for required datetime fields.
